title: fix(auth): sign-out follows the provider-logout redirect better-auth answers
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb4yxMPfMh63DDUTXPrF4itD)_
Fixes #26618

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** Console 的「退出登录」现在会跟随 better-auth 在 sign-out 应答里给出的身份提供方登出地址(`{ redirect: true, url }`),并把 Console 自己的登录页(`/_console/login`)作为 `callbackURL` 发给服务端。
- **为什么改:** 托管环境经 ObjectOS Cloud 登录时,退出只结束了环境会话,云端会话还在;同一台共享电脑上的下一个人点「使用 ObjectOS Cloud 继续」会免密登进上一个人的账号(cloud#3312 P5)。服务端早已给出登出地址,Console 是最后一跳,一直把它丢掉。
- **风险与回滚:** 只在应答带 `redirect: true` 且地址是绝对 `http(s)` 时才整页跳转;没有提供方的部署应答只有 `{ success: true }`,行为与今天一致。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts` 的 `signOut` 与 `providerLogoutURL`;`ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/signOutProviderLogout-26618.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/auth/src/__tests__/signOutProviderLogout-26618.test.tsx`,预期 11 条全绿。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `createAuthClient().signOut()` sends `callbackURL` = the SPA's own sign-in page, resolved under the basename of the document's `base` element the same way the password-reset link is (`/_console/login` on a hosted environment, `/login` at the origin root). better-auth 1.7.12 turns it into the provider's `post_logout_redirect_uri`.
- When the answer carries `redirect: true` with an absolute `http:` / `https:` URL, the client clears `TokenStorage` and then calls `window.location.assign(url)`. Every other answer (no `redirect`, a non-string or relative `url`, a `javascript:` or `data:` URL, an error) does not navigate. The client is built with `disableDefaultFetchPlugins: true`, which drops better-auth's `redirectPlugin`, so this follows the answer by hand, as `signInWithProvider` already does.
- The password-reset helper `resolveResetPasswordRedirect()` became `resolveSpaRoute(route)`, shared by both callers. The reset link it produces is unchanged.
- `AuthProvider.signOut()` is unchanged in code. Its state reset and `purgeSignedOutClientCaches()` still run before the page unloads, because `assign` only starts the navigation and the unload happens in a later task. Two comments say so.
- The exported `AuthClient.signOut` signature and return shape (a function returning a promise of `void`) are unchanged. No endpoint, server or spec change.

## Tests

New `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/signOutProviderLogout-26618.test.tsx` (happy-dom, real `createAuthClient` over a fetch double):

- a `{ success: true, url, redirect: true }` answer navigates to `url` once, the token is already cleared when `assign` runs, and the request body is `{ callbackURL: '/_console/login' }` with a `base` element whose href is `/_console/`;
- `callbackURL` is `/login` without a `base` element;
- `{ success: true }` does not navigate, and still clears the token;
- six answers that must not navigate: `redirect: false`, `redirect: 'true'`, a `javascript:` URL, a `data:` URL, a relative URL, a non-string URL;
- a 500 answer rejects, does not navigate, and clears the token;
- through `AuthProvider` with the real client `signOut`: the window follows the provider, the `objectui:metadata:*` entries are purged and the user is reset when `signOut()` resolves.

## Acceptance notes

- The cloud side still needs the environment's client registered with `post_logout_redirect_uris: [ENV_ORIGIN/_console/login]` and a framework pin move; the staging read for cloud#3313 runs after that (out of this repo).
- The Console's in-app route to the sign-in page still runs after `signOut()` resolves. With a provider answer, the full-page navigation to the provider replaces it.
